layout.heading: Get involved with IAS.
layout.text: Join the team, pitch an event or volunteer at the next one. Every chapter committee is built by students like you.

name: IEEE Industry Applications Society
tagline: Linking research to practice — engineering for the unique needs of industry and commerce.
about:
If your engineering interests are the needs of the industrial or commercial sector, the Industry Applications Society will be a valuable professional connection. One of the largest special-interest societies within IEEE, IAS focuses specifically on the unique needs of industry and commerce.

IAS is a source of professional power to nearly 10,000 members worldwide. Through a network of over 100 chapters, regional events and international conferences, the society keeps members abreast of current developments in electricity and electronics — and at Peradeniya we bring that to campus with hands-on workshops such as PLCs & SCADA systems.
